playback.note: Timing and loop behavior are intentionally unassigned until the approved asset layers and final scene review are available.

registration_contract.traveler_hand_grip_anchor: Each traveler pose must publish its own hand-grip pixel coordinate; place suitcase.png so its handle anchor meets that coordinate without a visual jump.
registration_contract.transparent_assets: All moving subject layers and the foreground occluder must be RGBA PNGs with inspected alpha. Do not infer transparency from a filename.

states.transition: Hold until the walk phase begins; start time pending.
Switch cycle poses using elapsed time and move along the approved platform path. Keep the suitcase at the per-pose hand-grip anchor; route and cadence pending asset/layout validation.
Decelerate and settle on the platform with foot contact; stop coordinates pending static scene approval.
Switch from the registered idle pose after settling; preserve body and foot registration.
Hold the look toward the approaching train; endpoint timing pending.
Begin on the visible track perspective; exact start position pending asset/layout validation.
Move along the track projection toward the viewer, deriving position and scale from one depth path; no independent screen-space drift.
End at a platform-safe position with wheels aligned to track geometry; endpoint pending validation.

concurrency: Traveler walk and train approach may overlap in time after the static compositor passes validation; exact overlap is unassigned.

gates.required: All files listed in asset-manifest.json as required_but_missing must be supplied or authored from the approved master, then validated.
Render approved layers with no animation; inspect perspective, scale, transparency, alignment, hidden-background reconstruction, and occlusion.
Begin motion only after explicit static-composition PASS and user visual acceptance.
